messages:
elaine: Heads-up — spotted a keyboard focus trap in the burst confirmation modal when using the SLO slider. Repro: open pool picker -> set min/max -> open burst -> tab cycles only inside modal and skips 'Apply to all routes' checkbox. Thoughts? rahul: repro'd. looks like focus is trapped but focusable elements order is wrong. tabindex on the slider container maybe swallowing focus. I'll attach quick steps: rahul: 1) open Dedicated pool modal 2) tab to SLO slider 3) press arrow keys to adjust 4) tab forward -> focus lands on invisible div instead of checkbox jon: Hmm — could be the custom slider implementation. We used a role="slider" div with keyboard handlers; need to ensure it doesn't set `tabindex="-1"` on the wrapper when active. Also copy for the checkbox might be unclear: 'Apply to all routes' -> maybe 'Apply these capacity settings to all inference routes' for clarity. morgan: From a11y perspective, the modal should announce the current SLO value when it changes. Screen readers aren't getting updates. Suggest aria-live="polite" on the value element. Also the slider should expose `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`. a11y-bot: Accessibility scan: 2 issues found — (1) missing aria-live for dynamic value (2) modal focus trap has tabindex loop. Severity: medium. rahul: quick patch idea: move interactive checkbox before slider in DOM so tab order matches visual order; add `aria-hidden="true"` to decorative divs; ensure slider element has proper aria attributes. jon: Visually, the slider value badge overlaps the confirm CTA at 320px width. Can we collapse the badge into the thumb on narrow screens? maybe show inline value next to label instead. elaine: Good call. Also we need a guardrail when users set burst > 5x — show inline warning: 'High burst may increase cost and throttling risk' with a learn more link. morgan: For screen reader users, the warning should be `role="alert"` so it gets announced immediately. rahul: I'll draft a small html snippet for the slider aria bits: rahul: ```html
20% ``` jon: Nice. Also let's add a visible focus indicator for the slider thumb (4px ring) and increase contrast on the disabled state for the checkbox. elaine: Owner: rahul to push small fix for aria attrs + DOM reorder. Jon to iterate responsive badge & copy. Morgan to verify announcements and alert behavior. I'll follow up with updated mock by EOD. :thumbsup: deploy-bot: deploy-preview available at https://deploy-preview/branch-ux-burst-aria (looks green) morgan: Quick note — when testing with NVDA, the slider's arrow keys change value but NVDA doesn't announce the new value without aria-live; verify after patch. rahul: will add unit test for tab order and a11y attributes, and upload PR in next hour. elaine: thanks team — let's not forget to add a changelog entry for the copy change and an e2e for the burst guardrail.
